info.title: RestaurantOS API
info.description: Restaurant ERP & POS. All responses are `{ data, meta? }`; errors are `{ error: { code, message, details?, requestId } }`.

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the access token expires

refreshToken.description: Refresh token. Browsers send it as the httpOnly `ros_rt` cookie instead.

stateCode.description: GST state code of the branch (two digits)
GST state code of the branch (two digits)

taxPricingMode.description: Menu prices include GST (INCLUSIVE) or GST is added on top (EXCLUSIVE)

invoicePrefix.description: Starts invoice, credit note, PO and GRN numbers; a new prefix starts a new series

stockDeductionPolicy.description: When sold items take ingredients out of stock

allowNegativeStock.description: false: items cannot be sent to the kitchen without enough stock

cashRequiresShift.description: true (default): cash payments and cash refunds need the cashier to have an open cash shift

branchId.description: null = all branches of the organization

password.description: Initial password (10–128 chars, letters and digits)

isActive.description: false deactivates the user and signs out all their sessions

rate.description: Total GST rate in percent. CGST and SGST are each half; IGST equals the rate.

stationCode.description: Kitchen station code that prepares this item
Kitchen station code that prepares this item

overrides.description: Replaces every override of this product in the branch

branchId.description: Omit to change availability in every branch

version.description: Optimistic concurrency: the version you last read

tableIds.description: Occupied tables whose sessions and orders join this table

until.description: Hold the table until this time

variantId.description: Required when the product has variants

unitPriceOverride.description: Price override per unit; needs billing.price.override and a reason

tableId.description: Required for DINE_IN: the table must be open

version.description: The version you last read; stale versions get 409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE

updateItems.description: Only for items not yet sent to the kitchen

payments.description: Split payments allowed; may be empty to print the bill first

method.description: Defaults to the original payment method

creditNoteId.description: The credit note this refund settles

restock.description: Return ingredients to stock (applied by inventory in Phase 5)

baseUnit.description: Stock is kept in this unit: g, ml or pc

unit.description: Unit of the quantity; default the ingredient's base unit

unitCost.description: Cost per counted unit, used to value opening stock

unit.description: Unit of the quantity; default the ingredient's base unit

unitPrice.description: Actual price per unit if it differs from the order

dueDate.description: Default: invoice date + supplier payment terms

openingBalance.description: Cash counted into the drawer at the start

type.description: CASH_IN: change added; CASH_OUT: cash taken out (bank deposit, petty cash)

actualCash.description: Cash counted in the drawer at closing

notes.description: Required when the count differs from the expected cash

taxAmount.description: GST included in the amount (for input tax credit)

employeeId.description: The employee who spent it or is reimbursed

fromCashDrawer.description: Paid in cash out of your open cash drawer

userId.description: Their login account (a user of this organization)
